scope: Static pre-GPU audit only. No extraction, HDF5 modification, split creation, GPU use, or training was performed.

current_trainer_behavior.implementation: trainer/train_model.py:34 calls create_group_split; dataloading/vibe_dataset.py:217 searches <data_root>/train/*_vibe.h5 after random.shuffle without a seed. trainer/train_model.py:62 searches <data_root>/val/*_vibe.h5 as test data.
current_trainer_behavior.observed_layout: GECV_VIBE_PRIMITIVES is absent; completed reconstruction files are flat at data/gecv_reconstruction_v1/*_recon_v1.h5.
current_trainer_behavior.video_level: The legacy utility groups filename prefixes, but it cannot discover the reconstruction filenames or guarantee the intended corpus-level split.
current_trainer_behavior.official_split_evidence: docs/phase5e_reconstruction_decision_protocol.md records the official GECV split as unresolved; no usable official split manifest was found in the repository.

smoke_samples.status: They are present in the completed corpus. The current trainer cannot load that corpus, but any future all-file split would include them unless they are explicitly reserved/excluded.
smoke_samples.recommendation: Reserve these three as smoke_only and exclude them from train/validation/test metrics because they were used for interface-gate development.

proposed_reconstruction_split.status: PROPOSAL ONLY; not created by this audit
proposed_reconstruction_split.algorithm: Deterministic per-class shuffle by source_id using NumPy SeedSequence(20260928), then allocate train/validation/test in a 70/15/15 ratio.

paper_vs_current_config.evidence_note: Paper target values below are the values supplied for this audit and echoed in README.md. Items absent from the paper-facing source are not inferred.

epochs.status: MATCH in legacy config; reconstruction template is not runnable

learning_rate.status: MATCH in legacy config; reconstruction template is not runnable

paper_vs_current_config.reconstruction_config_status: config/reconstruction_gecv_v1.yaml correctly sets reconstruction_mode, schema adapter, stored gamma, text OFF, and L_sat=0, but lacks data_root, log_dir, checkpoint_dir, batch_size, epochs, lr, optimizer settings, scheduler settings, and split-manifest support. It cannot be passed to trainer/train_model.py as a training config.

stages.output: global_v [768], local_p [8,32,768], audio_seq [32,768], masks, sync_mat [8,8], scalar stored gamma, env_feat=None, text_anch=None
stages.masks: validates local and audio masks; rejects a padded agent with valid local time
stages.gamma: read from HDF5 when configured as stored

stages.masks: local_time_mask zeros all four VIB outputs after encoding
local mask applied again after gate
local mask is visual self-attention key padding and output zeroing; audio mask is cross-attention key padding
masked mean over agents; temporal mask is local_time_mask.any(agent)

stages.stage: Global scene conditioning and Gamma-Gated Transformer
stages.masks: temporal key padding and post-layer zeroing
stages.gamma: gamma_prime=stored_gamma*scene_scale; AdaLN expands scalar gamma to 32 steps and modulates both layers
stages.global_scene: global_v directly drives global_style_proj and scene_scaler

stages.gamma: mean scalar is concatenated to h_final

path: DecoupledAdaLN expands [B,1,1] to [B,32,1] and applies gamma-dependent scale at model/gamma_transformer.py:31-49
gamma scalar also concatenated with h_final at model/vibe_model.py:145-148
gamma_path.physics_sync_note: The matrix is retained as batch sync_mat but is not passed to the model. The stored gamma is the model-visible synchrony signal.

path: model direct vector branch at model/vibe_model.py:70-71
global_scene_path.temporal_claim: None. The reconstruction code does not reinterpret global_scene as a temporal sequence.

mask_path.local_time_mask: Dataset validates it; model zeros VIB outputs (vibe_model.py:94-98), uses it for visual attention/output masking (118-121), masked agent aggregation/temporal mask (125-127), temporal attention key padding/post-layer masking (gamma_transformer.py:65-74), and temporal pooling (134).
mask_path.agent_mask: Dataset validates that a padded agent has no valid local time (vibe_dataset.py:107-108). In the actual passed-mask path it is not independently consumed by later modules; local_time_mask is the operative model mask. It is only used to construct a fallback local_time_mask when one is absent (vibe_model.py:62-65).
mask_path.audio_time_mask: Passed as cross-attention key-padding mask at vibe_model.py:121 and learned_attenttion.py:40-42. It does not prevent audio_proj from projecting padded values, but key/value positions are excluded by attention.
mask_path.real_data_test: The prior CPU integration test mutated 368 invalid local positions and observed max logit difference 0.0. H001/N001/S001 had 0 invalid audio bins, so audio masked-value mutation was not exercised.

loss_audit.L_HCE: Hierarchical label-smoothed cross entropy using Positive=0, Neutral=1, Negative=2.
loss_audit.L_KL: Unweighted VIB-affective KL sum divided by batch size.
loss_audit.L_ortho: Mean squared cosine similarity between flattened z_aff and z_env, weighted by lambda_ortho.
loss_audit.L_sat: Exactly zero when enable_sat=False; text_anch is None and no captions/text are fabricated.
loss_audit.reconstruction_requirement: A runnable reconstruction config must explicitly set enable_sat=false, lambda_sat=0.0, and lambda_ortho=0.1.

leakage_audit.feature_only_training: PASS in intended data path: VIBEDataset opens HDF5 tensors only; trainer does not import or invoke extraction code.
leakage_audit.historical_legacy_hdf5: The current configured root is absent. A future direct reconstruction manifest must point only to data/gecv_reconstruction_v1/*_recon_v1.h5 and reject paths outside it.
leakage_audit.phase5_phase6_pilot_data: Not reachable through the current legacy glob. A future manifest must exclude data/phase6_reconstruction_pilot/h5 and reserve H001/N001/S001 as smoke_only.
leakage_audit.captions: None; reconstruction HDF5 requires text_status=OFF and Dataset returns text_anch=None.

checkpoint_evaluation_audit.checkpointing: checkpoint_last.pth is overwritten each epoch. model_best.pth is written only when validation accuracy exceeds both best_acc=0.0 and save_threshold does not apply to this branch.
checkpoint_evaluation_audit.selection_then_test: Conceptually yes: trainer loads model_best.pth after the epoch loop and then calls test validation. In the present layout test is empty/nonexistent.
checkpoint_evaluation_audit.failure_risk: If no validation metric exceeds 0.0, model_best.pth is absent and final torch.load fails.

metrics.f1: weighted F1 only; macro F1 is absent
metrics.precision_recall: classification_report prints them only on the test branch
metrics.validation_reporting: The validation report/logging/confusion matrix branch is gated on nonempty text anchors, so it does not run for text-off reconstruction.
metrics.confusion_matrix: Available only through visualization branch, also text-gated; absent for current reconstruction.
metrics.class_order_bug: Test classification_report uses ['Pos','Neg','Neu'] at trainer/train_model.py:284, conflicting with canonical Positive=0, Neutral=1, Negative=2.

principal_activations: local input [16,8,32,768] is about 12 MiB float32
latent local tensors [16,8,32,512] are about 8 MiB each and several coexist during forward/backward
self-attention score tensors and gradients across two layers are the likely activation hotspot
gpu_readiness.recommendation: 24 GB GPU is the reasonable first class for batch size 16 in float32. Use memory monitoring on the first batch; 40/48 GB is contingency capacity, not a demonstrated requirement. H200 is not justified by this model's static memory footprint.

blockers: No deterministic, stratified train/validation/test manifest exists for the 407 reconstructed outputs.
The current trainer cannot discover the flat reconstruction corpus; its configured data root is absent and its legacy globs search train/*_vibe.h5 and val/*_vibe.h5.
No exact official paper GECV split is available, so paper-comparable evaluation must not be claimed.
No runnable reconstruction training config exists; config/reconstruction_gecv_v1.yaml lacks mandatory trainer fields and split-manifest selection.
Current scheduler/weight decay/warmup/dropout differ from the stated paper targets; text-off L_sat=0 is an intentional reconstruction deviation.
Evaluation reporting is incomplete for text-off reconstruction: macro F1/confusion matrix are absent, validation reporting is text-gated, and test class names use an incorrect Neutral/Negative order.
required_changes_before_gpu: Add a deterministic, stratified, video-level reconstruction split-manifest reader; do not create or copy HDF5 files.
Generate and freeze the proposed split manifest after explicit approval, including smoke_only exclusions and corpus hash.
Add a complete train_gecv_reconstruction_v1.yaml pointing exclusively to the frozen manifest and setting approved reconstruction interface/loss options.

Resolve and explicitly implement the approved reconstruction training schedule: paper-target cosine annealing plus 3-epoch warmup and weight decay 1e-3, or label any alternative as a reconstruction deviation.
Make current dropout choices explicit/configurable or document their divergence from the stated paper target.
Repair text-off validation/test reporting: correct class order, log accuracy/macro-F1/weighted-F1, precision/recall/classwise metrics, and confusion matrix without requiring text anchors.
Ensure a best checkpoint is always saved before final test evaluation.
recommended_next_step: Approve the proposed split protocol and the reconstruction training configuration decisions, then implement only the manifest-driven data split and text-off evaluation/checkpointing fixes; rerun a CPU train/validation/test integration gate before any GPU training.
